row_index_space: ROOT/cohort.csv original positional index, instance_ids stored alongside each reader subset
readers: readers/fold{f}_outer.npz and fold{f}_inner{k}.npz; 15 new layer1 readers; W[8,512] concatenates VV256 then VH256; intercept and full projection/head/fit parameters saved
features_source: features_source.npz: layer1[N,512], valid[N,2], computed[N], instance_ids[N]; uncomputed rows zero
summary_indices: source inner contains held only, source outer validation only, test outer test only; no train summary from its own outer fit
summary_aggregation: Each C4 view completes weighted mean, spatial/class centering and both softmax reads separately; then four-view mean. Invalid regions/pol are zero.
region_valid: [n,2,7]; global follows valid pol; each regional flag is area>0 and minimum C4 n_eff>=4
quality: [n,2,3,4], dynamic body/end/side only, fields area_px, coverage_fraction, min_C4_neff, region_valid; common to every arm
sigma: The sigma field inside regional summary NPZ is unused zero allocation; use scale_fold{f}_{tag}.npz sigma[n,2,8] for actual global sigma. It was only used to set source tau.
tau: per fold/pol in scales.json, copied into each summary NPZ; fixed before head training
fixed_template: source_templates.csv by reader/pol; medians over the reader fit indices, including separate inner fits
merged: dynamic region mu/h/b separately averaged over valid regions, equal region weights, denominator valid count; no area-weighted merge
intervention_entry: run_heads.load_info(fold,role,table), raw_inputs(base,info,arm), standardize(raw,checkpoint.mu,checkpoint.scale), Head(checkpoint.input_dim); preserve baseline and selected state
baseline: b0..b7 are exact historical two_sided_attention s0..s7 from corresponding source/test prediction CSV, matched by fold/seed/role/instance_id
not_fully_oof: New W and source summaries are reader-crossfitted; inherited T/attention source-training predictions are not whole-stack OOF.
